title: Publish native audit and schedule a five-minute repository scan
result: Local five-minute scheduled task and GitHub Actions workflow configured; scanner tested on 169 arm64 binaries; audit report ready to publish.
acceptance_criteria: Audit report is published to origin/develop without unrelated local changes.
Every five minutes, local Task Scheduler and GitHub Actions schedule a scan of native files and reconstructed source.
The scanner reports integrity and suspicious source patterns without claiming binary parity.
The scanner and schedule are tested and the local task is enabled.
